editorial_audit.notes: Final editorial audit (final acceptance, input checkpoint commentary-002). Checked: all 767 scaffold entries and 1048 units reviewed; redirect readability findings R-01..R-14 and the commentary-002 known issues applied; targeted re-reads only where a finding or a concrete inconsistency pointed (no whole-source cosmetic rewrite). Fixes: reversed ranking comments (PlayerBeatsRivals -> PlayerBehindRivals, A=$FF when behind; CompareTotals worsens the place by the deficit); RankPoints -> ParticipantRank (overall place 1..200) with LakeBestPlace/LakePlaceLimit/ClassPlaceBase and decimal place constants; sprite-list order attributes,dX,dY,tile; DataB858 -> CastAnimFrames/PowerCursorFrames split and rendered; TileMapAB35 -> LandingBoxTilesCopy; MUS_SCREEN_END -> MUS_STOP; CastPhase5Splash -> CastPhase5Bounce/BounceOffsets; DrawGreeting order; SndEnvelope1-9 renumbered to match SndEnvelopeTable (previous names contradicted the table); DL_LakeLabels -> DL_LakeMap (16x22 lake map pictures) with LakeMapPalette/Attr/Terrain/Picture labels; ~330 generic @skip/@loop labels renamed (remaining 56 @loop are in routines of <= 15 instructions); NT_ADDR(nt,row,col) for name-table addresses; ca65 character literals in name/code entry; CopyTilesInline sources symbolic with the bank per call site; address-based data names replaced (Tiles1bpp_/Tiles2bpp_/Tiles_ blocks, tile sources in banks 2-4/6); stale sound-number prose; headers for 50 header-less routines and notes for ~70 data tables; review summaries regenerated without truncation. Byte-identical rebuild verified after every batch. Residual: see commentary/editorial-audit.md (SFX_QUIET unmeasured, fight/retrieve visuals, per-frame extents of fish/lure/splash frame blocks, lake-bank internal tables kept as single blocks, some raw PPU high-byte immediates and address-suffixed duplicate text labels).
